handles.text: audit-shape-mulnw9yy: MoveDrag the frame or the chip anywhere: snaps to other objects, the slide's edges and centre and the guides; Shift keeps one axis, ⌘drag skips the snaps, Option drag drops a copy. Arrows nudge 1 px, Shift 10 px. ⌘Up and ⌘Down change the order.
